test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 2 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: For a regular polygon, the sum of the interior angles is 200% more than the sum of its exterior angles. Each interior angle of the polygon measures x°. What is the value of x°?
solution:
Given:

The sum of all interior angle of polygon 200% more than the sum of exterior angles.

Formula used:

The sum of all interior angle of a polygon = (n - 2) × 180°

Where n = number of sides

Calculation:

According to question,

Sum if interior angles of polygon

= 300% of 360°

= 3 × 360°

= 1080°

The sum of all interior angle of a polygon = (n - 2) × 180°

⇒ 1080° = (n - 2) × 180°

⇒ (1080°/180°) = (n - 2)

⇒ 6 = n - 2

⇒ n = 8

Now, each interior angle x = 1080°/8 = 135°

∴ The Required measure of x is 135°.
